sn21.6:1.2: His enlightenment came when being taught by Sāriputta ([ud7.1]()), who, however, underestimated him and kept teaching anyway ([ud7.2]()). His verses are at [thag7.2](). He was declared as the monk with the most charming voice ([an1.194]()). This discourse, with different verses, is also at [ud7.5]()
sn21.6:3.4: It is this verse that establishes the meaning “dwarf” for _lakuṇḍaka_, which does not appear elsewhere and has no Sanskrit cognate.
